title: Let's Learn English Lesson 20
subtitle: What Can You Do?
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 20: What Can You Do? (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, there! Washington, D.C. is a great place to work. Many people here work in government and politics. But there are many other jobs. You can work at a hospital; a university. You can work in a coffee shop. Wait a minute, I think I see a friend of mine. Pete? Is that you?
dialogue.zh: 嗨！华盛顿特区是个很好的工作地方。这里很多人在政府和政治领域工作。不过还有很多别的工作。你可以在医院工作；也可以在大学。你还可以在咖啡店工作。等一下，我好像看到一个朋友。皮特？是你吗？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You look different. Your beard … is really big.
dialogue.zh: 你看起来不一样了。你的胡子……真的很大。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: You don't like it, do you?
dialogue.zh: 你不喜欢，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, no. You just look … different.
dialogue.zh: 不，不。你只是看起来……不一样。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thank you. So, what's wrong? You look sad.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。所以，怎么了？你看起来很难过。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I don't have a job.
dialogue.zh: 我没有工作。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sorry, I can't hear you.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我听不清。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I do not have a job!
dialogue.zh: 我没有工作！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh. I'm sorry to hear that, Pete.
dialogue.zh: 哦。听到这个我很难过，皮特。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I don't have a skill.
dialogue.zh: 我没有本事。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Everyone has a skill. You need to find yours.
dialogue.zh: 每个人都有本事。你需要找到你的。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I don't know, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 我不知道，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete, I am good at asking questions. Let me ask you some.
dialogue.zh: 皮特，我擅长提问。让我问你几个。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Really, Anna? Can you help me?
dialogue.zh: 真的吗，安娜？你能帮我吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, I can. Let me help.
dialogue.zh: 能。让我来帮你。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Sure, Anna. Maybe you can help.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，安娜。也许你能帮上忙。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Can you write code?
dialogue.zh: 你会写代码吗？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Sure, c-o-l-d. How is this going to help?
dialogue.zh: 当然，c-o-l-d。这怎么能帮上忙？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, not "cold." Code; you know, for making phone apps, or websites. You can make tons of money writing code.
dialogue.zh: 不是“cold”。是代码；就是做手机应用，或者网站。写代码可以赚很多钱。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Tons of money? But I can't code.
dialogue.zh: 很多钱？可是我不会写代码。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Next question. Can you drive?
dialogue.zh: 下一个问题。你会开车吗？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Do you mean drive a race car? It's really hard to be a race car driver. First, you need a race car ...
dialogue.zh: 你是说开赛车？当赛车手很难。首先，你得有一辆赛车……

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, I mean drive a taxi or drive a bus.
dialogue.zh: 不，我是说开出租车或者开公交车。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: No, I always fall asleep when I drive.
dialogue.zh: 不行，我开车总是睡着。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, that's not good. Next question. Can you teach? You can be a teacher in a school.
dialogue.zh: 哦，那可不好。下一个问题。你会教书吗？你可以在学校当老师。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: No, I cannot teach.
dialogue.zh: 不，我不会教书。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Can you cook? You can be a chef in a restaurant.
dialogue.zh: 你会做饭吗？你可以在餐馆当厨师。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: No, I can't code! I can't teach! I can't cook! Anna, I can't do anything. This is sad. I'm gonna write about my feelings in my blog.
dialogue.zh: 不，我不会写代码！不会教书！不会做饭！安娜，我什么都不会。这太难过了。我要在博客里写写我的感受。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You write a blog?
dialogue.zh: 你写博客？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Yeah, I write a blog.
dialogue.zh: 对，我写博客。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: How many followers do you have?
dialogue.zh: 你有多少粉丝？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I don't know … 59,538.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete, that's a lot of followers! You can make money writing!
dialogue.zh: 皮特，那可是很多粉丝！你可以靠写作赚钱！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Writing is easy. Everyone can write.
dialogue.zh: 写作很容易。每个人都会写。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Not everyone can write well. You can be a writer!
dialogue.zh: 不是每个人都能写得好。你可以当作家！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I can be a writer. I can be a writer! I can be a writer! Thanks, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 我可以当作家。我可以当作家！我可以当作家！谢谢，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Hi, Pete. Hi, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，皮特。嗨，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Hi, Marsha. Excuse me, I have to go.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，玛莎。不好意思，我得走了。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Where are you going?
dialogue.zh: 你要去哪儿？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I'm going to be a writer!
dialogue.zh: 我要去当作家！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Good luck, Pete!
dialogue.zh: 祝你好运，皮特！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: He does know that it's not easy to be a writer, doesn't he?
dialogue.zh: 他知道当作家并不容易，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: There are many different jobs you can have in Washington, D.C. Pete wants to be a writer. I wish him luck. Lots of luck. Until next time!
dialogue.zh: 在华盛顿特区，你可以做很多不同的工作。皮特想当作家。我祝他好运。很多好运。下次见！
